dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge with a smooth spline curvature transitioning from a sharp apex to the posterior body insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep angular margin oriented at approximately 65 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High vertical-to-horizontal ratio with the fin height exceeding the visible base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate radius convexity forming a smooth arc from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio relative to the cranial volume.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the steep melon slope meets the dorsal margin of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly luminous green specular highlights across the dorsal and melon surfaces; visible polygonal mesh artifacts along the ventral and caudal margins.
